summary: Slice 01.01 scaffolded the pi-interactive-widgets package and shipped the headless browser and page layer; U1 passed and U2 found Chrome Local Network Access blocking loopback from the widget origin.

Slice 01.02 shipped the kitty transport, environment detection, a standalone tmux harness, and perf scripts; U4 passed visually in Ghostty 1.4.0, input and AC01 passed, AC02 passed on marginal cost, and the T01 segment review passed.

Slice 02.03 finished the Pi integration core with click-to-wake under tmux, replacing frozen 02.01 under revision R001; checks and e2e passed and the user confirmed click-to-wake and the AC11 regular-to-fullscreen behavior.

Final slice 02.02 added the lifecycle, revive, scaling, recovery, and cleanup policy plus README and whole-plan acceptance; AC01-AC16 passed with user-confirmed AC12-AC14, both review gates passed, and the item was archived as completed.
